meta.name: StyleKit Curatorial Frame
meta.description: The existing StyleKit brand DNA extracted from the homepage, style catalog, brand lockup, and implementation tokens.

accent.role: index signal and selected style emphasis

neutral.usage: Monochrome structure stays quiet so each curated style can introduce its own palette.

color.contrast_strategy: Dark-on-paper dominant with black reverse bands and one fluorescent index accent.

font_families.heading: Playfair Display, Noto Serif SC, Songti SC, serif
font_families.body: Albert Sans, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Editorial serif establishes curation and taste; neutral sans supports product scanning; mono labels index the archive.

spacing.section_rhythm: Large editorial hero, compact index rails, then systematic catalog grids.

layout.grid_system: Editorial 12-column grid with visible registration lines
layout.alignment_tendency: mixed asymmetric hero with strict catalog grid

elevation.depth_cues: Borders, offset frames, overlapping specimen sheets, and preview color contrast.

motion.exit_pattern: Quick fade or direct state switch

components.button_style: Square black primary, outlined secondary, compact mono utility actions
components.input_style: Square 1px border with visible focus ring
components.card_style: Square specimen frame with live style preview, palette strip, and indexed metadata
components.navigation_pattern: Centered editorial masthead with restrained utility controls
components.modal_style: Paper surface with strong border and high-contrast controls
components.list_style: Catalog grid and indexed horizontal scenario rail
components.component_notes: The shell behaves like an archive or gallery system; the preview area is allowed to inherit the curated style.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A curatorial frame and living visual style archive
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary editorial publishing and Swiss catalog systems

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous paper margins separate product explanation from dense style previews.
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Large serif promise balanced by a colorful live preview specimen.
visual_language.focal_strategy: distributed interest through curated style specimens
visual_language.texture_usage: Subtle paper/grid texture; no cinematic material rendering in the product shell.

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy and framed live previews
composition.flow_direction: Promise to proof to searchable archive
composition.grouping_strategy: Overlines and numbered rails label each content family.
composition.negative_space_role: Keeps the curatorial frame neutral so individual styles remain legible.

imagery.photo_treatment: Product screenshots and real UI previews are primary; generated imagery must be visibly assigned to a specific style example.
imagery.illustration_style: Varies by curated style and never defines the global shell.
imagery.graphic_elements: Grid lines, SK aperture, palette strips, numbered labels, and specimen frames

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Direct border, inverse-color, and small positional feedback
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Card lift by 2px, stronger border, preview scale around 1.02
interaction_feel.loading_style: Skeleton or static specimen frame that preserves layout

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Offer a next filter, style, or prompt to explore.
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Plain-language explanation with a concrete recovery action.

overview.fallback_strategy: Static CSS layout with all previews and content visible

scroll_morphing.description: Style changes occur inside framed previews, not across the global shell.

image_effects.description: Preview scale is the only image treatment

svg_animations.description: SK monogram and utility icons stay static

visual_effects.composite_notes: The StyleKit shell should hold rather than compete. Color, illustration, photographic treatment, glass, brutalism, and other effects belong inside the curated preview frames. The global experience stays fast, paper-like, typographic, and product-evidential.
